dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you are Jean and Barbara's...

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Yes, Jean and Deaconess Barbara are my daughters.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: May the Anemo Archon forgive my negligence. As their father, I should have shouldered more responsibility for them.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: But our Deaconess is always so incredibly diligent that she won't even let me help her out. And Jean... her temperament is perhaps too much like her mother's.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: So... All I can do is pray to the Anemo Archon. May His grace lighten their burdens, if only by a little.
